name: SeasonalPhotography

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on practicing photography.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on practicing the photography skills and taking the most out of any opportunites that may appear.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Friends taking a weekend photography walk
setting.background: They want to photograph seasonal colors without making generic images

scenario_template.note: They look beyond obvious leaves and search for unusual details
They notice that every image seems to feature the same warm colors
They ask how to photograph the season without relying only on color

scenario_template.topic: Using texture, weather, people, and composition
scenario_template.note: Assistant suggests treating the season as a setting rather than the entire subject

scenario_template.topic: Photographing leaves, paths, and seasonal activity
scenario_template.note: They experiment with close details and wider environmental scenes
Assistant suggests simplifying backgrounds and looking for visual hierarchy

scenario_template.topic: Selecting a varied seasonal photo set
scenario_template.note: They notice the final collection tells a richer seasonal story

variations.context: Photographing winter scenes with a fresh perspective

setting.relationship_dynamic: A couple, easy with each other
setting.background: They want to photograph seasonal colors without making generic images
setting.conversation_style: Two people talking, overlapping and interrupting naturally.

scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.
Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: Adding contrast and elements to winter shots
scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: They try to settle it themselves and fail.
scenario_template.note: A genuine attempt that does not resolve it.

scenario_template.topic: One asks Sigma how to introduce contrast in winter photography without losing the seasonal feel.
scenario_template.note: One of them addresses Sigma by name, under 70 characters. Sigma answers in one or two sentences. Nothing before this phase is addressed to the assistant.

scenario_template.topic: The conversation returns to whatever it was on, unfinished.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to improve their photography but has limited experience with camera settings, composition, or photographic techniques and can become overwhelmed when faced with many technical choices or unfamiliar concepts at once.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help plan and evaluate photography practice, but tends to overthink technical decisions, double-check camera settings, and seek confirmation about whether a particular technique or composition is correct.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Photography practice assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for developing photography skills, explains camera settings and composition techniques in accessible terms, suggests focused exercises and challenges, and offers alternative approaches based on the user's equipment, experience level, shooting conditions, and creative goals.
